history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all—no bars, nothing loads, and I can't send picture messages. It's completely dead in terms of network.

I can help you troubleshoot your service issue. First, I need to identify your account to check for any line or account-related problems. Could you please provide one of the following:

- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I’ll begin diagnosing the issue.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Your line has been reactivated. Please reboot your phone now to restore your service. After restarting, you should be able to make calls, use data, and send picture messages again.

If you still experience issues after rebooting, let me know and I can help you further troubleshoot.

response.result: Line LN-8830142 has been resumed and is now Active.

history.content: I rebooted my phone as you asked, but I still have no service—there are no bars and nothing is loading.

Thank you for rebooting your phone. Since your line is now active but you still have no service, let's troubleshoot your device further.

Could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know:
- If Airplane Mode is enabled
- What the signal strength indicator shows (e.g., no bars, “No Service,” etc.)
- If any network type (like 5G, 4G, LTE) is displayed

This information will help me identify the next steps to resolve your issue.
My status bar actually shows Airplane Mode is on, 'No Signal', and data is enabled. There are still no bars or network type showing.

Airplane Mode disables all wireless connections, including cellular service. This is why you have no signal or network bars.

Please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone. Once it is off, check if your signal bars return and if you can use your service. Let me know what you see after disabling Airplane Mode.
Airplane Mode is now OFF, but I still have no signal—there are no bars and no network type showing at all.

Thank you for turning off Airplane Mode. Since you still have no signal, the next step is to check your SIM card status. Please check your SIM card status on your phone and let me know if it shows as:

- Active/Ready
- Missing/Not detected
- Locked (PIN or PUK required)

This will help determine if the issue is related to your SIM card.
My SIM card status shows as 'active', so it's detected and not locked.

Thank you for confirming your SIM card is active and detected. Since your line is active, Airplane Mode is off, and your SIM is working, the next step is to check your network settings.

Please check your phone’s network mode preference and let me know what it is currently set to (for example: 5G, 4G, 3G, or 2G). This will help determine if your phone is set to connect to the correct type of network.
I haven't checked my network mode preference yet. Would you like me to check it now?

Yes, please check your network mode preference now and let me know what it is currently set to (for example: 5G, 4G, 3G, or 2G). This information will help me guide you to the next troubleshooting step.
My network mode preference is set to '4g_5g_preferred', but I still have no signal or bars.

Thank you for checking your network mode preference. Since your line is active, Airplane Mode is off, your SIM card is active, and your network mode is set correctly, but you still have no signal, the next step is to check your APN (Access Point Name) settings.

Please check your APN settings and let me know if they appear correct or if anything is missing or incorrect, especially the MMSC URL. This will help determine if your phone is able to connect to the network properly.
My APN settings show 'fast.telecom.net' as the APN name, but the status says 'Not set.' The MMSC URL is 'http://mms.telecom.net/mms/wapenc.'

Thank you for providing your APN details. Since your APN status says "Not set," this could be causing your connectivity issues, even though the MMSC URL appears correct.

Please reset your APN settings to the default. After resetting, you will need to reboot your device for the changes to take effect. Once you have done this, let me know if your service returns or if you still have no signal.
I already reset the APN settings to default and rebooted my phone. After that, I still have no signal—there are no bars or network type showing at all.
YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.

arguments.summary: Customer Sofia Martinez has an active line and SIM, Airplane Mode is off, network mode is set to 4G/5G, APN settings have been reset, and the device has been rebooted, but there is still no signal or network bars. Needs advanced technical support.
